create_infsampler: create an InfSampler instance to infinitely sample dataset indices with optional shuffling
create_distributed_infsampler: create a DistributedInfSampler to partition infinite sampling across distributed training replicas and ranks
reset_permutation_infsampler: reset the permutation of an InfSampler to generate a fresh random ordering of indices
use_infsampler_next: use the next method of InfSampler to get the next dataset index auto-resetting when exhausted
use_distributed_infsampler_next: use the next method of DistributedInfSampler to get the next index for the current rank
